title: Otter Bay Marina
gap: Prices for moorage or services not stated
blurb: Otter Bay Marina is located in the heart of the Gulf Islands and serves as a stop for multi-port cruises or a destination for boaters in the Salish Sea. The marina offers moorage with power and water (when available), two pools, lawn games, and a store. Use of amenities is limited to guests with reservations on the dock or mooring ball; day use of facilities is not provided.
